Title: Info
Text:
We added standard actions on 4D Write Pro objects. It can be defined by designing or by programming.

You can use standard actions in 3 different ways:
* Associate a standard action with an object from the property list
* Associate a standard action to a menu item
* Use the new command "INVOKE ACTION"

Title: Example 1
Text:
In this example, we associate to the object button a 4D Write Pro standard action in the Property list.

Click on the "Toggle horizontal ruler" button to try.

Title: Example 2
Text:
In this example, we add the new INVOKE ACTION command in object method of the object button.

Click on the "Toggle horizontal ruler" button to try.

Title: Example 3
Text:
In this example, we associate a 4D Write Pro standard action to a menu item in Tool Box dialog.

Click on the "4D Write Pro / Show horizontal ruler" menu item to try.

Title: Example 4
Text:
In this example, we associate a 4D Write Pro standard action to a pop up menu with SET MENU ITEM PROPERTY command.

Click on the "Menu / Toggle horizontal ruler" pop up menu item to try.

Title: Example 5
Text:
In this example, we associate a 4D Write Pro standard action to a menu item in Tool Box dialog. This action named "fontStyle" displays a sub menu with "Bold", "Italic", "Underline" and "Strikethrough".

Click on the "4D Write Pro / Style" menu item to try.

Title: Example 6
Text:
In this example, we replace the default 4D Write Pro contextual menu by its own contextual menu.

Click with the right button on the "4D Write Pro" area to try.
